content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through a process described through any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. The notice also lists, under a second "Essential Qualification" heading: Bachelors in Ceramic Engineering, Materials and Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Nanoscience and Nanotechnology, Ceramic Engineering; Masters in Physics, Materials Science. M. Tech in Materials Science & Engineering, Materials and Metallurgical Engineering. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice calls the post a temporary assignment in a purely time-bound research project. It prints no HRA or other allowance.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Kharagpur JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research in the Materials Science Centre.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of application is December 05, 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship, GATE, or national level examinations conducted by Central Government bodies. M. Tech in Materials Science & Engineering or Materials and Metallurgical Engineering is the desired experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Kharagpur JRF?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The notice prints the fee as Rs. 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. If the fee is deposited, the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) should be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the tenure, and is the post permanent?
faq.answer: The post is a temporary assignment in a time-bound research project. The tenure is 36 Months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Which agency sponsors the project?
faq.answer: The project is sponsored by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), and the PI/Co-PI is Prof./Dr. Shibayan Roy.
